item.title: Woman found dead outside north Tulsa home
item.description: Tulsa police are investigating after a woman's body was found on the front porch near 61st Street North and Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard early Friday.

item.description: Around 2 a.m. a suspect is in critical condition after pulling a pistol on police and ignoring orders from the officers.

item.title: Car hits and kills 24-year old pedestrian on I-44
item.description: A 24-year-old pedestrian died Sunday morning around 5 a.m. after being hit by a car. OHP says that Brian Fleming was pronounced dead at the scene

item.title: 19-year-old missing, Oklahoma Highway Patrol reports
item.description: OHP reported 19-year-old Jordan Serkland missing Saturday afternoon. He was last seen at 317 West Detroit Ave on March 28.

item.title: Man shot, killed near 41st and Garnett
item.description: Police are responding to a shooting on East 41st street and South Garnett Road. Police say a 36-year-old man was shot multiple times in the chest and was sent to the hospital for his injuries.

item.title: Man shot in the face after shootout near 41st and South Zenith
item.description: A shootout between two cars led to a man being shot in the face on 41st and South Zenith Sunday afternoon. The man went to the hospital and is in critical condition.
